title: Shinobi Journey desktop and mobile presentation review
scope: Player-facing screens, navigation, menu sections, creator stages, dialogs, story readers, companion workflows and combat presentation.

corrections.finding: The 320px layout left 121px for destination copy; Firefox's medium desktop layout also squeezed the copy below 180px.
corrections.change: Preserve the user's preferred two-column desktop design. Between 760px and 900px of directory width, reduce artwork and gutters to protect copy width; narrower directories use one column. Compact phones use art banners above full-width copy.

corrections.finding: Hidden horizontal guidance and stat carousels consumed the opening phone viewport and obscured choices.
corrections.change: Show the recommendation and benefit immediately, disclose detailed guidance, and display every stat group in a responsive grid. Preserve training rules and costs.

corrections.finding: The bottom timer choices required scrolling on short landscape phones. WebKit did not restore focus to the selected stat after dismissal.
corrections.change: Compact the header, padding and decorative icons below 420px of landscape height; all four choices fit together. Pass the clicked stat as the explicit dialog focus-return target.

corrections.finding: A populated desktop deck made the sticky list approximately 2797px tall.
corrections.change: Bound the desktop rail to the viewport and give it its own scrolling. Mobile retains normal page scrolling. Verify the last card and footer actions remain reachable by keyboard.
Add consistent spacing, a readable balance summary, themed product borders and a grid that fits narrow containers. Keep purchase behavior and pricing copy intact.
Allow long titles to wrap, prevent close controls from shrinking, remove the card's intrinsic minimum width, and account for top and bottom safe areas in maximum dialog height.

corrections.finding: A compact phone's short race canvas clipped most pause settings and actions inside a narrow scrollable overlay.
corrections.change: Use a viewport-sized, themed modal above the race stage, with focus containment and return, 48px controls and a 16px graphics selector. Verify the normal menu fits without internal scrolling.

corrections.finding: Compact-phone transfer choices could overlap the footer and intercept Cancel or confirmation clicks.
corrections.change: Give the scrolling choices and action footer separate grid rows; remove intrinsic minimum widths from the fieldset and wrap destination copy.

corrections.finding: Inline-flex level requirements escaped narrow merchandise cards and widened the phone viewport, including subsequently opened dialogs.
corrections.change: Render requirement and price metadata as bounded, wrapping blocks within each card. Check low-level characters as well as unlocked stock.

evidenceLocation: Representative images ship beside this report. Full screenshots, traces and measurements remain in shinobij.client/test-results/; Sunscar captures are in .tmp/sunscar-mobile-ux-qa/ and Chronicle captures in .tmp/presentation-chronicle/.
catalogReconciliation: The 46-screen restoration walk is supplemented by all six creator stages, public profiles, populated battle records, three profession variants and transfer choosers, cinematic/classic story readers, three dungeon seals, ceremony/awakening states, companion workflows, combat renderers, Sunscar submenus and the card-duel encounter hosts. Stateful encounters are reached through isolated fixtures because URL restoration alone cannot open them. Admin authoring/operations screens are outside the player-facing scope; retired route identifiers without render branches are not screens.
auditMaintenance: Added compact-phone, landscape and browser projects; menu, dialog, creator and full-deck regression checks; populated workflow config; screenshot-walk tools; pet-duel screenshots; and reliable empty-body reset and asynchronous race-exit checks in the Sunscar harness.
method: Responsive browser emulation, screenshot inspection and layout/input assertions with isolated fixture saves and test-server accounts. Physical-device certification and every possible live player-data combination are outside this pass.
